Tests batch bytes extraction with per-input config (extract_batch)

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val result = Xberg.extractBatch(listOf(mapper.readValue("{\"bytes\":\"pdf/fake_memo.pdf\",\"config\":{\"output_format\":\"markdown\"},\"filename\":\"fake_memo.pdf\",\"kind\":\"bytes\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)), ExtractionConfig())
    println(result)
}
```
